2608.13410.title: Who Speaks Matters: Authority-Aware Multi-View RAG over Italian Parliamentary Proceedings
2608.13410.paper_summary: Parliamentary proceedings are a primary record of democratic deliberation, yet their volume and fragmentation make multi-perspective access difficult for citizens, journalists, and researchers. Applying Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to parliamentary transcripts introduces three specific risks: dominance of the most frequent speakers, inability to weight speakers according to topical expertise, and citation misattribution in politically sensitive text. We present ParliamentRAG, a RAG system for the Italian Chamber of Deputies that addresses these risks jointly. Its core contribution is a topic-dependent authority model that estimates each speaker's authority as a function of the current query, combining interpretable components such as profession, education, and previous interventions. Given a user query, the system retrieves relevant speech chunks, identifies topic-relevant experts across parliamentary groups, and generates a summary synthesizing their perspectives, accompanied by supporting quotations. ParliamentRAG is evaluated against Google NotebookLM on 15 policy topics via a two-level protocol combining automated metrics and blind A/B human evaluation by six domain experts. The system achieves higher coverage across political groups (0.97 vs. 0.95), perfect quotation faithfulness (1.00 vs. 0.95), and stronger expert preferences on source-related dimensions, while NotebookLM remains stronger on prose-oriented dimensions.
2608.13410.paper_summary_zh: 國會程序是民主審議的主要記錄，但其數量和碎片化使得公民、記者和研究人員難以從多角度獲得信息。將檢索增強生成（RAG）應用於國會記錄引入了三個特定風險：最常發言者的主導地位、無法根據主題專業知識對發言者進行加權，以及在政治敏感文本中的引用錯誤歸屬。我們提出了ParliamentRAG，一個針對意大利眾議院的RAG系統，旨在共同解決這些風險。其核心貢獻是一個依賴主題的權威模型，根據當前查詢估算每位發言者的權威性，結合可解釋的組件，如職業、教育和先前的發言。給定用戶查詢，系統檢索相關的演講片段，識別各國會小組中的主題相關專家，並生成綜合他們觀點的摘要，附上支持性引用。ParliamentRAG在15個政策主題上通過一個結合自動指標和六位領域專家的盲測A/B人類評估的兩級協議，與Google NotebookLM進行評估。該系統在政治群體的覆蓋率上達到更高（0.97對0.95），引用忠實度完美（1.00對0.95），在來源相關維度上表現出更強的專家偏好，而NotebookLM在以散文為導向的維度上仍然更強。
